text:
I sing because the instant exists

and my life is complete.

I am not joyful and I am not sad:

I am a poet.


Brother of fugitive things,

I feel neither pleasure nor torment.

I cross nights and days

in the wind.


If I crumble or if I build,

if I remain or undo myself,

—I do not know, I do not know. I do not know whether I stay

or pass.


I know that I sing. And the song is everything.

The rhymed wing has eternal blood.

And one day I know I will be mute:

—Nothing more.

translation.title: Motive
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves Meireles's poised ars poetica: song as everything, and silence as the final limit.
